description: The workspace's newest webhook deliveries, newest first: the event, whether it was delivered, is still being tried (with the next attempt's time) or failed, how many attempts, and the last error and HTTP status. Give endpoint_id for one endpoint. A failed one can be sent again with replay_webhook_delivery.

endpoint_id.description: One endpoint's deliveries (list_webhooks gives ids). Leave out for all.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: Webhook deliveries
